stem.text: The diagram shows a uniform plank XY of length $4.0\,\text{m}$ and weight $300\,\text{N}$.

stem.alt: Diagram of a horizontal plank with a triangular support at each end, labelled X at the left end and Y at the right end. A child stands on the plank near X. The distance between the supports is marked 4.0 m. Printed labels: child, plank, support.

stem.text: The plank rests on fixed supports at its ends X and Y.
A child of weight $600\,\text{N}$ stands in different positions on the plank.
The support at end X exerts a force $F$ vertically upwards on the plank.
What is the magnitude of $F$ when the child stands at X and when the child stands at Y?
